item.title: CONFIRMED: NYGREN IN, IHEANACHO ON BENCH
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN gets the nod to take over from banned Reo Hatate against FC Utrecht in the Europa League encounter at Parkhead tonight. The Swede, the Hoops’ top scorer this season with 13 goals, will partner Callum McGregor and Arne Engels in midfield while there is a place among the stand-by squad for Kelechi Iheanacho. [...]

item.title: CELTIC 4 FC UTRECHT 2: DOUBLE DUTCH FOR MARTIN
item.description: CELTIC 4 FC UTRECHT 2 MARTIN O’NEILL and his Celtic players completed a Dutch double to seal their place in tomorrow afternoon’s Europa League knock-out draw. The Hoops swept aside FC Utrecht after storming into a three-goal lead inside 20 minutes to add their scalp to that of Feyenoord who were beaten 3-1 in Rotterdam [...]

item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL is hoping for three cheers on three fronts over the next three days.
